The equation is a Pell equation, and its smallest positive solution comes from the continued fraction of √29.

√29 = [5; 2, 1, 1, 2, 10], which has period 5 (odd). So the first convergent that solves x² − 29y² = −1 is 70² − 29·13² = 4900 − 4901 = −1.

Squaring gives the fundamental solution of the +1 equation:
(70 + 13√29)² = (4900 + 29·169) + 2·70·13·√29 = 9801 + 1820√29.

Check: 9801² − 29·1820² = 96059601 − 96059600 = 1.

Every other positive solution is a power of this one and is larger, so the smallest has x + y = 9801 + 1820 = 11621.

ANSWER: 11621
